header: SAML attributes for ﬁne-grained access control
content:
subjectKey
Maps to a unique user attribute, such as email or username, that identiﬁes the user for
authentication.
rolesKey
Maps to group or role attributes in your IdP that determine the roles or permissions for
authorization.
